Definition: Puah or Puvvah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Puah, also called Puvvah, is the name of two Israelites. Puvvah was a son of Issachar who went down into Egypt with Jacob, and his descendants are counted among the families of Issachar. And Puah was the father of Tola, who judged Israel twenty-three years after Abimelech.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that two men share one name and both are counted: the son who went into Egypt and the father of a judge, and God counts both of them.
